attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. ONE independent high-resolution 65:67 portrait-card fusion. Image 1 is the exact original small game card and sole authority for visible composition, clothes, pose and hair. Image 2 is mascot anatomy/identity only; its bare scalp must not erase source hair. VISIBLE SOURCE HAIR IS REQUIRED where actually present.
Actually observed source features: Almost frontal elderly head slightly toward image-left, olive/khaki peaked cap, dark visor with visible gold leaf-like edging and pale/gold central naval badge footprint. Clearly visible short LIGHT GREY TEMPLE HAIR and LIGHT GREY EYEBROW HAIR must remain as actual hair. CLEAN-SHAVEN smooth upper lip/chin, stern closed mouth. Khaki naval jacket with OPEN lapels, khaki shirt, dark tie, small gold collar-detail footprints and gold shoulder board. Preserve source hat shape, lighting, source crop and garment fastening; no added moustache, beard or spectacles.
The exact source has a slightly tilted complete dark rectangular photo frame, OPAQUE grey photo backing, and cream note overlapping the lower-right, with faint indistinct multirow short upper-note marks. Preserve exact overlap, shadows, crop and frame silhouette.
Replace the depicted human anatomy with the reference mascot: smooth warm golden-yellow body, compact rounded head, green-ringed black eyes and simple mascot mouth. Preserve the source-visible hairstyle, hairline, eyebrow HAIR and facial hair exactly where actually present; keep original head direction, gaze, closed-mouth expression and all clothing/accessories. Do not infer details from a person name, filename or biography. Only use the exact source-visible features described above. Preserve actual moustache hair where visible; keep the chin and upper lip smooth only where the source is actually clean-shaven. No extra people, readable writing or unsupported symbols.
The round chin meets the existing neckline through a VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition. Refit collar and shoulders to that body shape while preserving original garment style, fastening and overlap. No long narrow yellow neck, floating collar, clipping, neck rolls or cream belly patch at the collar. The mascot reference full-body pose and bare scalp do not replace the original card crop, clothes or hair.
Retain the FULL dark photo frame, opaque painted/photo backing, cream overlapping note, shadows and every solid surface. Preserve the upper-note faint short marks at the original position/footprint/contrast as indistinct strokes; add no readable writing and do not erase the note. Preserve genuine transparency only OUTSIDE the entire complete frame-and-note silhouette; no internal transparent holes or faded face, hair, collar or clothing. Painterly game portrait finish; one asset only, no comparison sheet, new label, text or watermark.
Anatomy fit: a near-round or SHORT egg-shaped head, with its rounded chin immediately meeting a raised and broadened original collar/shoulder line. Keep the actual OPEN or CLOSED garment style. Do not fill an open shirt V with an elongated yellow tapered funnel, neck stalk or extra neck roll; no separate exposed vertical neck column below the chin. The collar front overlaps the very short broad neck base and its rear sits behind it.
FINAL SOURCE-FEATURE REQUIREMENT: Almost frontal elderly head slightly toward image-left, olive/khaki peaked cap, dark visor with visible gold leaf-like edging and pale/gold central naval badge footprint. Clearly visible short LIGHT GREY TEMPLE HAIR and LIGHT GREY EYEBROW HAIR must remain as actual hair. CLEAN-SHAVEN smooth upper lip/chin, stern closed mouth. Khaki naval jacket with OPEN lapels, khaki shirt, dark tie, small gold collar-detail footprints and gold shoulder board. Preserve source hat shape, lighting, source crop and garment fastening; no added moustache, beard or spectacles.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.

Grey brows/temple hair, clean-shaven face, khaki cap/jacket/shirt/dark tie, short broad collar fit, frame/backing/note and exterior-only alpha are retained. The cap badge lost the source clearly visible pale spread-wing bird form and became a single tall silver anchor inside a leafy wreath. Restore the actual pale bird-over-gold-anchor-like footprint with a separate built-in cap-detail repair; preserve original visor trim and all already correct features. Fine engraving/lettering is indistinct and not demanded or invented. Larger original was analysis only, not an image tool input.
